THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Protein Cereal Hack

Keep your cereal. Upgrade your milk.

YIELD1 serving
TOTAL TIME1 min
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVING~210 cal | ~20g protein

Ingredients

Ingredients

  • 28g cereal (1 measured serving — S'mores, Cinnamon Toast Crunch, whatever you like)
  • 1/2 cup Fairlife Fat Free Ultra-Filtered Milk
  • 1/2 serving Opportuniteas Grass-Fed Whey Protein Isolate (unflavored)

You want cereal but need protein. No cooking, no prep, no compromise. +15g protein in 60 seconds.

Method

  1. 1.MIX PROTEIN MILK. Add 1/2 scoop unflavored whey isolate to 1/2 cup Fairlife. Shake or whisk until fully smooth. No clumps.
  2. 2.POUR. Pour protein milk over 28g measured cereal.
  3. 3.EAT. That's it. No cooking, no prep.

SPLIT PLATE SERVING

Adult: Serve the adult portion as described above.

Kid: Serve the kid portion as described above.

If something fails

Milk is clumpy / gritty: You didn't mix properly. Use a blender bottle or whisk hard. Protein goes in milk FIRST, not on cereal. Pro tip: make it the night before so it's not frothy from shaking.

Cereal tastes weird: You used flavored whey. Only unflavored isolate works — vanilla/chocolate ruins the cereal taste.

Feels like too little food: 28g is a real serving. Most people free-pour 3x that. Measure once so you know what a serving looks like.

Kids want more: That's fine — give them a normal portion with regular Fairlife. Don't over-optimize kids.

Storage and reheating

Store: N/A — 60 seconds to make.

Reheat: N/A.

Lasts: N/A — eat immediately, cereal gets soggy.
